name: EVOUNA
description: EVOUNA is a dataset designed for the Evaluating QA Evaluation (QA-Eval) task, which assesses the accuracy of AI-generated answers compared to standard answers in Open Question Answering (Open-QA). It aims to facilitate the development of more effective automatic evaluation tools by providing human-annotated results to measure evaluation method performance.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark in the QA-evaluation literature, mainly cited for human-annotated evaluation of automatic answer scoring methods rather than broad leaderboard use.
notes: Focuses on evaluating the evaluation methods for Open-QA answers; highlights limitations of current automatic evaluation methods and the importance of human evaluation.
